name: e14
description: E14 Fabric latency against payload size on QChain's network rebuilt on the Mac (Fabric 2.5.15, 2 organisations, Raft orderer, shared CouchDB): QChain-shaped transactions whose envelopes match E13's issueCredential for 8 signature schemes, plus the smallest transaction; sequential (each waits for its commit) and burst (all at once); 5 repetitions; drift-control blocks at the start, middle and end. Target envelopes are E13's medians (N = 5 attributes of 16 bytes).
